content: This information is not intended to serve as personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance provided by your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and to address your specific health needs. Please note that this information was last updated in May 2024. It is important to understand how to use this information: it is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. This information does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or suitable for your individual circumstances. Always seek advice from your healthcare professional to obtain complete and accurate information about this product and your unique health requirements. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same category. To access formulary information, you must first create a list of plans. This list will be saved and can be modified at any time. Adding plans enables you to make informed comparisons. The information provided here is for general informational and educational purposes only. Individual plans may differ, and formulary information is subject to change. For the most up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly. When sending this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
